content.comment_body: Hello, I am trying to measure temperature using a type K thermocouple and have a signal converter with a 0-10 V output. The model I use is [product_name]. How should I connect this to the [product_name] module? I believe the positive output should go to the analog input, for example I7, but I am unsure where to connect the negative output. Thanks for any guidance.
You should connect the negative lead to the common ground (M) of your power supply.
Connect the "+" of the 10V output to I7 of the [product_name] and the "-" to the common ground (M or 0V) of its power supply.

The main issue is ensuring correct grounding and wiring for accurate readings, with responses clarifying how to connect the signal converter's output leads to the module and the power supply ground.
